caption: The drawing depicts a textile pattern arranged in a square format divided into four equal rectangular sections by wide, dark green borders that form a cross shape. Each section features a repeated symmetrical motif consisting of four green shapes resembling stylized leaves or petals, arranged around a central, similarly green, X-shaped form, making a total of sixteen of these stylized leaf shapes in the entire composition. The background of each section is a light beige or pale pink color with subtle swirling, feather-like patterns within the lighter areas. The entire piece is framed by a wide, uneven dark green border matching the color of the motif and inner lines. The image uses primarily two colors: a dark green for the motifs and borders, and a pale pinkish-beige for the background.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
